title: Web Server header responses CR+LF issue
symptom: When fetching the xDrip web server URL (e.g., /pebble) programmatically, the HTTP response headers contain only LF instead of CR+LF, causing Node.js and other GET libraries to throw an insecure header violation.
fix: The issue was resolved in the July 8th nightly build, as stated by a maintainer: 'Please try July 8th nightly which should resolve the issue.'
evidence_quote: Please try July 8th nightly which should resolve the issue.
